CreatureEvent("FourthTaintBossesPrepareDeath") onPrepareDeath: the lethal-damage trigger (game.cpp combatChangeHealth runs PREPAREDEATH events when realDamage >= health).
Returns without effect unless the killer is a player.
creature:getHealth() - realDamage < 1 repeats the lethal-damage condition of the trigger.
killer:getTaintNameByNumber(4): the killer holds the fourth Soul War taint, a quest KV flag (soul_war.lua Player:getTaintNameByNumber) that the quest domain publishes read-only (D27).
killer:getSoulWarZoneMonster() ~= nil: the killing player stands in one of the zones of SoulWarQuest.areaZones.monsters (soul_war.lua Player:getSoulWarZoneMonster).
math.random(1, 10) == 1: a 10% chance.
creature:say(...) with the default talk type (say).
creature:addHealth(creature:getMaxHealth()) heals to full. game.cpp then still drains the lethal hit capped at the health before the heal, so the creature survives.
SoulWarQuest.areaZones.monsters lists the zones whose union is the anchor area.
The last monster.events assignment replaces the first; Mirror Image leaves hunting_monster and has only MirrorImageTransform.

Accepted Q1a adds Dreadful Harvester from the cited wiki evidence; text is DERIVED from this voice line, not an existing Canary teleport callback. (§13.1/13.6)
SW-5 reads addArea/subtractArea and six lever specPos; Q2a normalizes Rotten Wasteland reversed x corners to the stated full rectangle.

SW-3/Q1a: first-taint holders only; 2-second repeating checks; farthest candidate; 10% chance, 2-second warning, 10-second cooldown after a successful move. The skipped taint test, 1-second check and logout-stuck cooldown are accepted source deviations; no path requirement.
SW-4/Q5b: own player damage transforms by base vocation; weights 28:3:3:3:3 produce 70%/7.5%; full health. Other damage cannot kill it. No-vocation removal is omitted as an accepted deviation.
The separate player DoT path is superseded by accepted Q5b: all own player damage follows the same weighted full-health transformation.
SW-6/Q6a pool creation remains blocked: whether repeated hits stack pools or enlarge one pool is unverified. No unless_present choice or covers claim is made.
